scope: labels and placement of the prespecified primary-pair paired-block bootstrap output
trigger: After the frozen RxRx1 run, all four original U-statistics lay below the corresponding empirical 2.5th percentile of the paired-block bootstrap statistic.
mathematical_reason: Resampling eight block identifiers with replacement duplicates observations. Applying the conventional observation-level U-statistic to duplicated rows changes its diagonal-exclusion structure: duplicate draws enter off-diagonal within-arm sums as self-kernel terms and reweight same-block cross-arm terms. The resulting small-sample bootstrap distribution need not be centered on the original statistic.
reporting_decision: The four frozen quantile pairs are preserved without recomputation.
They are labeled as the empirical 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of the paired-block bootstrap statistic.
They are not labeled or interpreted as confidence intervals, coverage intervals, or precision bounds.
The sole primary test remains the complete paired-swap test for the canonical quotient endpoint.
The Euler paired-swap value is labeled unadjusted secondary; raw and moment-registration values remain diagnostics.
